content: Apple guidelines: 3.1.1 requires a restore mechanism for restorable IAP; 5.1.1(i) requires privacy policy link in App Store Connect metadata AND inside the app; 3.1.2(c) requires clear pre-purchase description and Schedule 2 of the PLA governs subscription disclosures (Terms of Use/EULA link required in metadata for auto-renewable subs); 3.1.2(a) subscription period min 7 days; must not take away primary functionality existing users already had.
